sessbar.focus: Bring this terminal to front and use it for SFTP
settings.disconnectOnLock: Close all sessions when the vault is locked
settings.disconnectOnLockHelp: Recommended. If unchecked, SSH sessions and tunnels stay open after locking, with terminals hidden until you unlock (only decrypted remote files are wiped). Their connections stay usable and the secrets they already used stay in memory until they close.
settings.recalibrate: Recalibrate on this machine (master password required)
settings.sftpFollow: SFTP: automatically enable terminal folder following (injects a line into the shell)
settings.sftpFollowTitle: Types a line into the remote shell on each connection (bash/zsh). No remote file is modified.
settings.terminalHighlight: Colorize terminal output (errors, warnings, IPs, URLs)
settings.terminalHighlightHelp: Fixed rules, never applied in full-screen programs (vim, htop…) or over colors set by the server. Session logs stay uncolored. Applies to sessions opened afterwards.
settings.terminalTabs: Terminals in tabs inside the main window
settings.terminalTabsHelp: Applies to sessions opened afterwards. Terminals appear above the dashboard, one tab per session, instead of separate windows.
settings.tip.autolock: Locks the vault after this many minutes of inactivity. 0 = never.
settings.tip.clipboardDefault: What programs on the server may do with your clipboard (OSC 52): nothing, read, write, or both. Can be overridden per folder or connection.
settings.tip.clipboardTtl: Clears the clipboard after this many seconds when you copy a secret. 0 = never clear.
settings.tip.copyOnSelect: Automatically copies any text selected in the terminal to the clipboard.
settings.tip.fontSize: Terminal font size. Applies to sessions opened afterwards.
settings.tip.importKnownHosts: Adds the fingerprints from ~/.ssh/known_hosts to HarakaTS's known hosts (existing ones are kept).
settings.tip.kdf: Recalculates the key-derivation cost (Argon2) suited to this computer, keeping unlock fast while staying resistant. Requires the master password.
settings.tip.keyring: Stores the vault key in the system keyring so you can unlock without the master password. Less safe: avoid on a shared computer.
settings.tip.locale: Interface language. Terminal windows already open keep their language until reopened.
settings.tip.logRetention: Automatically deletes session logs older than this many days (at unlock). 0 = never.
settings.tip.parallelism: Number of SFTP transfers running at the same time.
settings.tip.pasteConfirm: Asks for confirmation, with an exact preview, before pasting multi-line text or text containing control characters (protects against paste hijacking).
settings.tip.purgeLogs: Deletes now the logs older than the retention period set above.
settings.tip.scrollback: Number of lines kept in the terminal history (scroll back). Higher = more memory.
settings.tip.serverStatus: Periodically checks whether each server answers: a plain TCP connection to its SSH port, closed right away (no ICMP ping, no SSH exchange). Off by default. One check per host:port, at most 8 in parallel, 2 s timeout; servers behind an SSH jump host are not checked (grey dot).
settings.tip.serverStatusInterval: Delay between two rounds of checks (15 to 3600 s). Longer = less network traffic.
settings.tip.theme: Application appearance: follow the system, or grey, blue, light.
settings.title: Vault settings
